# Brendon Mapinda — Creative Studio + Automation Lab

> Cape Town–based creative studio and automation lab run by Brendon Mapinda. Two paths, chosen from the landing page: premium photography & content (the Studio), and software & automation (Systems). Brand promise: premium visuals, smart systems, business growth — helping brands look premium and run smarter.

## Site structure

- **Landing** (`/`): a chooser — Photography & Content, or Software & Automation.
- **Studio** (`/studio.html`): photography & video.
- **Systems** (`/systems.html`): AI automation, software & business optimization.

## The Studio (photography & content)

Editorial portraits, brand & venue content (lounges, bars, products, personalities), cinematic short-form reels for Instagram/TikTok, and event coverage (graduations, baby showers, brand activations). Photographer/cinematographer since 2017, with eight years refining a single editorial aesthetic: premium, moody and lifestyle-led, with every photo edited by hand. Photos and reels made for Instagram and WhatsApp, and memories clients can come back to. Paid client work includes Reebok South Africa, GoodHope FM and matric dances, alongside portraits of Miss SA contestants. Shoots are in person, in Cape Town only.

Session pricing (South African Rand): Mini R1,000 (1 hour, 1 look and 1 location, 25 edited photos, 1 reel) · Signature R2,000 (most booked, 1.5 hours, 2 looks or 2 locations, 50 edited photos, 1 reel) · Premium Creative R3,000 (2 hours, groups or shoots that need lighting, 70+ edited photos, 2 reels with the client's own clips if wanted, client directed). Event coverage is quoted on request. Every session includes creative direction, every photo edited by hand, and full quality files on Google Drive. Transport is not included, the client arranges it or it is added to the quote.

## Systems (software & automation)

AI automation and AI agents, custom web app and software builds, business-process optimization, and AI discoverability (structuring products and content to be found and recommended inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Meta AI, Perplexity and AI search). Background as an AI-augmented data & migration engineer; 15+ applications built and deployed in under a year. Delivered remotely for clients anywhere in the world, as well as across South Africa.

Pricing (South African Rand, indicative): Website from R3,500, most landing between R3,500 and R8,000 · Automation from R7,500 (one workflow), most landing between R7,500 and R15,000 · Custom Build from R15,000, most landing between R15,000 and R40,000. Monthly care after launch (first month free with every build): Hosting R250 a month or R2,500 a year (domain, hosting, SSL, backups, uptime checks, security updates; small changes R250 each, bigger work R450 an hour) · Site Care R850 a month (Hosting plus up to 4 small changes a month and a monthly visitors and enquiries report) · Systems Care R1,500 a month (running costs, monitoring and same-day fixes for apps and automations; changes R450 an hour). Every build is scoped to the problem.

Selected work: TNDetailing (https://tndetailing.co.uk), quote requests with photos, a job gallery and gift vouchers for a mobile car detailer in South West England. VibesMap (https://vibesmap.co.za), Cape Town restaurants, bars and happy hours found by vibe and budget. Tsakani Sessions (https://tsakanisessions.co.za), events, bookings and a back office for a Cape Town DJ collective. M&M Cellars (https://mmcellars.co.za), QR code wine ordering. Giyant Business Solutions (https://giyant.co.za), a company site. Glory Domain (https://glorydomain.org), a church community app. Tom's Landscaping (https://tomslandscapingsomerset.co.uk), an enquiry site and private quotes office for a UK landscaper.
